flows.title: Publish a landing page from the Page Overview
steps: In Unbounce, click a page on the All Pages screen to open its Page Overview.
At the top-right corner of the Page Overview, click the blue Publish button.
From the drop-down menu, click Publish Now.
A pop-up suggests things to double-check before publishing. When you're ready, click Publish Page.
Once the page is live, the button at the top-right of the Page Overview changes to Unpublish, which takes the page down again.

flows.title: Build a popup
steps: In Unbounce, select Popups & Sticky Bars from the left-hand menu.
Click the blue Create New button on the right-hand side.
Select Popups under Pick a content type.
Select a popup template, or click Blank Popup.
Name the popup to suit your campaign and click Start with this Template.
Design the popup, using the Desktop and Mobile toggle buttons to switch between the two versions.
When you're done, click the Save button at the top right corner.
Click the Overview button at the left-hand corner of the builder to go back to the Popup Overview, where its URL targeting, trigger and frequency are set.
